data.name: Space Dart
data.detailed_description:
Defend Earth by defeating alien challengers in strategic dart matches.

Space Dart is a single-player darts game where you compete against AI opponents across two classic game modes:

Count Up and Zero One. Each match combines traditional darts with unique gameplay mechanics.

Targets move while your dart is in flight, requiring precise timing, prediction, and careful aiming.

Every turn introduces new tactical decisions as you choose whether to use one of ten special items before throwing. Features 

• Two classic dart game modes:

- Count Up

- Zero One 

• Challenge AI opponents with three difficulty levels:

- Easy

- Normal

- Hard 

• Use 10 different special items, including score manipulation, target control, item stealing, score swapping, and more.

• Moving targets with randomized movement patterns create a different challenge every turn.

• Play using either keyboard or mouse controls.

• Each match lasts around five minutes, making Space Dart easy to pick up while still rewarding strategy, precision, and smart item usage.

Can you defeat your alien rivals and protect Earth!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 9 compatible graphics card with 1 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 100 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
  • Additional Notes: Keyboard and Mouse required
